newsitem.title: USA: Dekalb may use AgrEvo trademark - judge.
newsitem.headline: Dekalb may use AgrEvo trademark - judge.

text.p: A judge on Tuesday turned down a request by the Hoechst Schering AgrEvo GmbH joint venture for an emergency restraining order to block Dekalb Genetics Corp from using Hoechst's Liberty trademark, a court spokeswoman told Reuters.

At issue is Hoechst Schering's assertion that it has the right to approve which seed manufacturers can claim their genetically engineered seed corn is resistant to glufosinate in the Liberty brand herbicide. Resistance allows a corn crop to withstand a spraying that destroys weeds.

Vice Chancellor Bernard Balick ruled against the joint venture after a hearing Tuesday. He said he believed that Dekalb had shown that its use of the word Liberty in marketing its seed was a "fair use", a legal source told Reuters.
